sources.title: How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs
Why are birds the only surviving dinosaurs?

facts.statement: 66 milyon yıl önce dinozorlar çok kötü bir gün geçirdi; yok oluşun tarihi 66,0 milyon yıl öncedir.
facts.quote: Sixty-six million years ago, dinosaurs had the ultimate bad day. / the date of the dinosaur extinction is 66.0 million years ago.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Dünya'daki hayvanların yaklaşık %75'i, dinozorlar dahil, aynı zamanda aniden yok oldu.
facts.quote: Around 75% of Earth's animals, including dinosaurs, suddenly died out at the same point in time.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Asteroitler Güneş'in çevresinde dolanan büyük, kayalık cisimlerdir; Güneş sisteminin yaklaşık 4,6 milyar yıl önceki oluşumundan arta kalan parçalardır. Bu asteroidin 10–15 kilometre genişliğinde olduğu düşünülüyor.
facts.quote: Asteroids are large, rocky objects that orbit the Sun. / rocky, airless remnants left over from the early formation of our solar system about 4.6 billion years ago. / The asteroid is thought to have been between 10 and 15 kilometres wide,
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs; NASA Science — Asteroids

facts.statement: Çarpma yeri Chicxulub krateri olarak bilinir ve merkezi Meksika'daki Yucatán Yarımadası'ndadır; krater 150 kilometre çapındadır.
facts.quote: The impact site, known as the Chicxulub crater, is centred on the Yucatán Peninsula in Mexico. / the velocity of its collision caused the creation of a much larger crater, 150 kilometres in diameter.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Asteroit yüksek hızla çarptı ve fiilen buharlaştı; dev bir patlama dalgası ve sıcak dalgası yayıldı, atmosfere çok büyük miktarda madde savruldu.
facts.quote: The asteroid hit at high velocity and effectively vaporised. / A huge blast wave and heatwave went out and it threw vast amounts of material up into the atmosphere.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Dev dalgalar Amerika kıtalarının bazı bölgelerini kapladı; büyük yangınların kanıtları da var.
facts.quote: caused massive tidal waves to wash over parts of the American continents. / There's also evidence of substantial fires from that point in history.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Kurum bütün dünyaya yayıldı; Güneş'i tamamen kapatmadı ama yeryüzüne ulaşan ışığı azalttı ve bitki büyümesini etkiledi.
facts.quote: It sent soot travelling all around the world. / It didn't completely block out the Sun, but it reduced the amount of light that reached the Earth's surface. / So it had an impact on plant growth.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Domino taşları gibi, bu durum besin zincirinin üst basamaklarını etkiledi ve ekosistemin çökmesine yol açtı.
facts.quote: Like dominos, this had knock-on effects up the food chain, causing the ecosystem to collapse.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: 1980'de fizikçi Luis Walter Alvarez ve jeolog oğlu Walter, iridyumca zengin tarihsel bir kil tabakasının büyük bir asteroidin Dünya'ya çarpmasından kaynaklandığı kuramını yayımladı. İridyum Dünya'da bulunan en nadir metallerden biridir.
facts.quote: In 1980, Nobel Prize-winning physicist Luis Walter Alvarez and his geologist son Walter published a theory / that a historic layer of iridium-rich clay was caused by a large asteroid colliding with Earth. / Iridium is one of the rarest metals found on Earth.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Alvarez hipotezi başta tartışmalıydı ama bugün en yaygın kabul gören kuramdır; krater bulunmuştur ve yaşı kuş olmayan dinozorların yok oluşuyla tam olarak aynıdır.
facts.quote: The Alvarez hypothesis was initially controversial, but it's now the most widely accepted theory / An asteroid impact is supported by really good evidence because we've identified the crater, / It's exactly the same age as the extinction of the non-bird dinosaurs, which can be tracked in the rock record all around the world.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Suç yalnızca asteroitte değildir: çarpışmadan önce Dünya bir iklim değişikliği dönemindeydi; bugünkü Hindistan'ın orta kesiminde iki milyon yıl boyunca çok büyük volkanik etkinlik sürdü; asteroit son, öldürücü darbeydi. Öldürme mekanizması hâlâ tartışılıyor.
facts.quote: The blame can't solely rest on the asteroid. / Prior to its crash landing, Earth was experiencing a period of climate change. / In what's now central India, there was substantial volcanic activity / For two million years there was a huge amount of volcanic activity going on, / The asteroid was the final, killer blow. / There is a lot of discussion over the actual kill mechanism and how long that period lasted.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Ammonitler, bazı mikroskobik planktonlar, pterozorlar ve büyük deniz sürüngenleri yok oldu; ağırlığı 25 kilogramın üstündeki bütün kara hayvanları da yok oldu.
facts.quote: Among them, ammonites, some microscopic plankton, pterosaurs and large marine reptiles all died out. / But all land animals weighing over 25 kilogrammes died out.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Bitkiler hayvanlardan daha az etkilendi; çünkü tohumları ve polenleri zor dönemlere daha uzun dayanabilir.
facts.quote: plants were less affected than animals because their seeds and pollen can survive harsh periods for longer.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Hayatta kalanlar başlangıçta küçüktü; kuş olmayan bütün dinozorlar yok oldu ama dinozorlar kuşlar olarak hayatta kaldı.
facts.quote: Initially the survivors were small, with birds the first to experience evolution to larger sizes. / All of the non-bird dinosaurs died out, but dinosaurs survived as birds.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — How an asteroid ended the age of the dinosaurs

facts.statement: Kuşlar teropod denen etçil bir dinozor grubundan evrildi; hayatta kalmalarında büyük olasılıkla küçük bedenleri, çok farklı besinler yiyebilmeleri ve uçabilmeleri etkili oldu; bugün en az 11.000 kuş türü vardır.
facts.quote: Birds evolved from a group of meat-eating dinosaurs called theropods. / The answer probably lies in a combination of things: their small size, the fact they can eat a lot of different foods and their ability to fly. / Today there are at least 11,000 bird species.
facts.location: Natural History Museum — Why are birds the only surviving dinosaurs?

facts.statement: Dinozorların yok oluşu memelilerin gelişip büyümesine olanak verdi.
facts.quote: In the case of the Cretaceous extinction, the demise of the dinosaurs allowed mammals to thrive and grow larger.

facts.statement: NASA'nın bir birimi, Dünya için çarpma tehlikesi oluşturabilecek asteroit ve kuyrukluyıldızları bulma, izleme ve daha iyi anlama görevini yürütür.
facts.quote: manages NASA's mission to find, track, and better understand asteroids and comets that could pose an impact hazard to Earth.

facts.statement: Yaklaşık 66 milyon yıl önce, Kretase döneminin sonunda beşinci kitlesel yok oluş yaşandı.
facts.quote: Finally, about 66 million years ago, at the end of the Cretaceous period came the fifth mass extinction.
